voice_name: Tyler - Clear US YouTube Creator Voice
full_text: Right now, your existence is sliced into little colored boxes on a glowing screen. Before your feet hit the floor, you look at a glass rectangle to see who owns your morning, who owns your afternoon, and how many minutes you get for lunch. You sprint through honking traffic, cram onto a packed subway train, and trade ten hours of your life answering messages from strangers. And tonight, before you sleep, you will set that same machine to scream at you again. Now, rewind forty-five thousand years.
